customers_say: Customers are impressed with the smart lock's reliability, noting that the face unlock feature works quickly every time, and appreciate its user-friendly app interface. The lock features a simple door handle design that matches well with home decor, and customers find it convenient to use. They praise its build quality and installation process, and consider it a good value for money.

reviews.author: PARAG SACHANIA
reviews.title: Sleek and utilitarian
reviews.body: Excellent Smart Lock with Premium Looks and Features I recently purchased the Native Lock Ultra by Urban Company from Amazon, and so far, I am very impressed with the product. The lock has a sleek, premium-looking design and blends really well with the door. What I particularly like is the variety of access options available — fingerprint, face recognition and RFID, in addition to the other conventional options. reviews.title: Excellent smart lock with great build quality
reviews.body: Really impressed with the Native Lock Ultra. The build quality feels premium, installation was smooth, and the lock works reliably. The smart features are convenient and make everyday access much easier. Overall, a great product for the price and definitely worth recommending.

reviews.title: The live video feature is commendable.
reviews.body: Fantastic purchase... The live video feature is commendable. Helps me stay at ease as far as security is concerned. The premium build makes the door look very lively.

reviews.title: Great Smart Lock with Premium Features
reviews.body: Great smart lock! Premium design, easy to use, and the app features like remote unlocking, live view and instant notifications work really well. Feels secure and premium. Happy with the purchase! Worth the price.
